text: 1，整体走势：市场全天探底回升，三大指数集体反弹。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4200股飘红，今日成交2.31万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.4%，深成指涨1.1%，创业板指涨1.55%。 2，行业板块：食品、乳业、零售、游戏等板块涨幅居前，光刻机、存储芯片、先进封装、玻璃基板等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：食品、乳业、零售等消费股集体走强，欢乐家、李子园、东百集团等多股涨停。游戏股震荡拉升，电魂网络、恺英网络、巨人网络涨停。汽车整车板块反弹，北汽蓝谷涨停。券商等金融股午后走高，华林证券涨停。下跌方面，光刻机概念股调整，茂莱光学、新莱应材跌超10%。
text_en: 1, Overall trend: The market recovered from a morning dip, with all three major indices rebounding. Most stocks rose, with over 4,200 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets gaining, and total turnover reaching 2.31 trillion yuan. The Shanghai Composite closed up 0.4%, the Shenzhen Component up 1.1%, and the ChiNext up 1.55%. 2, Sectors: Food, dairy, retail, and gaming led gains, while lithography, memory chips, advanced packaging, and glass substrates lagged. 3, Hot concepts: Consumer stocks such as food, dairy, and retail strengthened, with multiple stocks like Huanlejia, Liziyuan, and Dongbai Group hitting limit up. Gaming stocks rose, with Dianhun Network, Kaiying Network, and Giant Network hitting limit up. Auto stocks rebounded, with BAIC BluePark hitting limit up. Brokerage and financial stocks gained in the afternoon, with Hualin Securities hitting limit up. On the downside, lithography concept stocks adjusted, with Maorui Optical and Xinlai Materials falling over 10%.
